arxiv-1902-00909.title: An Invitation to Quantum Channels
arxiv-1902-00909.creator: Vinayak Jagadish, Francesco Petruccione
arxiv-1902-00909.description: Abstract Open quantum systems have become an active area of research, owing to its potential applications in many different fields ranging from computation to biology. Here, we review the formalism of dynamical maps used to represent the time evolution of open quantum systems and discuss the various representations and properties of the same, with many examples.

arxiv-2109-07072.title: Qurzon: A Prototype for a Divide and Conquer Based Quantum Compiler for Distributed Quantum Systems
arxiv-2109-07072.creator: Turbasu Chatterjee, Arnav Das, Shah Ishmam Mohtashim, Amit Saha, Amlan Chakrabarti
arxiv-2109-07072.description:
A 2021 arXiv research paper by Turbasu Chatterjee, Arnav Das, Shah Ishmam Mohtashim, Amit Saha, Amlan Chakrabarti. firstpage,color=gray!60,angle=90,scale=0.32, xpos=-4.05in,ypos=0]

firstpage,color=gray!60,angle=90,scale=0.32, xpos=3.9in,ypos=0]

When working with algorithms on quantum devices, quantum memory becomes a crucial bottleneck due to low qubit count in NISQ-era devices. In this context, the concept of ‘divide and compute’, wherein a quantum circuit is broken into several subcircuits and executed separately, while stitching the results of the circuits via classical post-processing, becomes a viable option, especially in NISQ-era devices.

arxiv-2301-08242.title: Modelling the cosmological Lyman-Werner background radiation field in the Early Universe 2023 Modelling the cosmological Lyman-Werner background radiation field in the Early Universe – C
arxiv-2301-08242.creator: Andrea Incatasciato, Sadegh Khochfar, Jose Oñorbe
arxiv-2301-08242.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Andrea Incatasciato, Sadegh Khochfar, Jose Oñorbe. The Lyman-Werner (LW) radiation field is a key ingredient in the chemo-thermal evolution of gas in the Early Universe, as it dissociates H 2 \text{H}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\vphantom{\text{2}}\smash[t]{\text{2}}}^{\vphantom{\smash[t]{\text{2}}}\hphantom{\text{2}}\text{}} molecules, the primary cooling channel in an environment devoid of metals and dust. Despite its important role, it is still not implemented in cosmological simulations on a regular basis, in contrast to the ionising UV background.

arxiv-2307-15251.title: PCNN: A Lightweight Parallel Conformer Neural Network for Efficient Monaural Speech Enhancement
arxiv-2307-15251.creator: Xinmeng Xu 1 , Weiping Tu 1,2,3,∗ , Yuhong Yang 1,3
arxiv-2307-15251.description: Abstract Convolutional neural networks (CNN) and Transformer have wildly succeeded in multimedia applications. However, more effort needs to be made to harmonize these two architectures effectively to satisfy speech enhancement. This paper aims to unify these two architectures and presents a Parallel Conformer for speech enhancement.

arxiv-2412-07617.title: Swarm Behavior Cloning
arxiv-2412-07617.creator: Jonas Nüßlein 1 , Maximilian Zorn 1 , Philipp Altmann 1 and Claudia Linnhoff-Popien 1 1 Institute of Computer Science, LMU Munich, Germany jonas.nuesslein@ifi.lmu.de
arxiv-2412-07617.description: Abstract In sequential decision-making environments, the primary approaches for training agents are Reinforcement Learning (RL) and Imitation Learning (IL). Unlike RL, which relies on modeling a reward function, IL leverages expert demonstrations, where an expert policy π e \pi_{e} (e.g., a human) provides the desired behavior.

arxiv-2505-23373.title: Optimal Control by Variational Quantum Algorithms
arxiv-2505-23373.creator: Tangyou Huang, Jing-Jun Zhu, Zhong-Yi Ni
arxiv-2505-23373.description: Abstract Hybrid quantum-classical algorithms hold great promise for solving quantum control problems on near-term quantum computers. In this work, we employ the hybrid framework that integrates digital quantum simulation with classical optimization to achieve optimal engineering of quantum many-body systems.

arxiv-2510-07302.title: SpecGuard: Spectral Projection-based Advanced Invisible Watermarking
arxiv-2510-07302.creator: Inzamamul Alam, Md Tanvir Islam, Simon S. Woo, Khan Muhammad
arxiv-2510-07302.description: Abstract Watermarking embeds imperceptible patterns into images for authenticity verification. However, existing methods often lack robustness against various transformations primarily including distortions, image regeneration, and adversarial perturbation, creating real-world challenges. In this work, we introduce SpecGuard, a novel watermarking approach for robust and invisible image watermarking.

arxiv-2602-10498.title: When Skills Lie: Hidden-Comment Injection in LLM Agents
arxiv-2602-10498.creator: Qianli Wang (labc9666@gmail.com)
arxiv-2602-10498.description: Abstract Abstract LLM agents often rely on Skills to describe available tools and recommended procedures. We study a hidden-comment prompt injection risk in this documentation layer: when a Markdown Skill is rendered to HTML, HTML comment blocks can become invisible to human reviewers, yet the raw text may still be supplied verbatim to the model.

pmc-10741646.title: Cholesterol-Enriched Hybrid Lipid Bilayer Formation on Inverse Phosphocholine Lipid-Functionalized Titanium Oxide Surfaces
pmc-10741646.creator: Tun Naw Sut, Joshua A. Jackman, Nam-Joon Cho
pmc-10741646.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Hybrid lipid bilayers (HLBs) are rugged biomimetic cell membrane interfaces that can form on inorganic surfaces and be designed to contain biologically important components like cholesterol. In general, HLBs are formed by depositing phospholipids on top of a hydrophobic self-assembled monolayer (SAM) composed of one-tail amphiphiles, while recent findings have shown that two-tail amphiphiles such as inverse phosphocholine (CP) lipids can have advantageous properties to promote zwitterionic HLB formation.

pmc-11339947.title: Trends of electronic cigarette use among adolescents: A bibliometric analysis
pmc-11339947.creator: Wenqi Chen, Gaoran Chen, Shaojie Qi, Jinzheng Han
pmc-11339947.description: INTRODUCTIONThe use rate of electronic cigarettes (e-cigarettes) among adolescents is continuously rising globally, posing new challenges to public health and negatively impacting adolescent health. This study employs bibliometric methods to systematically present the current state and evolving trends in global research on adolescent e-cigarette use.

pmc-11428254.title: Antimicrobial Effects of Metal Coatings or Physical, Chemical Modifications of Titanium Dental Implant Surfaces for Prevention of Peri-Implantitis: A Systematic Review of In Vivo Studies
pmc-11428254.creator: Maria Gkioka, Xiaohui Rausch-Fan, Jinzhi Han, Serena Riela, Carlos M Franco
pmc-11428254.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Introduction: Peri-implantitis poses a significant challenge for implant dentistry due to its association with bacterial colonization on implant surfaces and the complexity of its management. This systematic review aims to assess evidence from in vivo studies regarding the antimicrobial efficacy of titanium (Ti) dental implant surfaces following physical/chemical modifications or the application of various metal element coatings in preventing bacterial growth associated with peri-implantitis.

pmc-11544080.title: Assessment of Garcinia kola Heckl value chain and its contribution to the livelihoods of local populations in Eastern Cameroon
pmc-11544080.creator: Marlène Tounkam Ngansop, Preasious Forbi Funwi, Mireil Carole Votio Tchoupou, Jules Christian Zekeng, Cédric Djomo Chimi, Evariste Fedoung Fongnzossie
pmc-11544080.description: The value chain analyses of a product can provide vital information for improving the production, value addition, market organization and boost the contribution of the product to the income of the stakeholders involved. Hence, this study was carried out on the Garcinia kola value chain in Belabo, Cameroon.

pmc-11560778.title: Dexamethasone and IFN-γ primed mesenchymal stem cells conditioned media immunomodulates aberrant NETosis in SLE via PGE2 and IDO
pmc-11560778.creator: Khushbu Priya, Hiral Thacker, Manaswi Chaubey, Madhukar Rai, Shambhavi Singh, Sonali Rawat, Kiran Giri, Sujata Mohanty, Geeta Rai
pmc-11560778.description: BackgroundSystemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE) is characterized by dysregulated immune responses, with neutrophil extracellular traps (NETs) playing a significant role. NETs are recognized by autoantibodies in SLE patients, exacerbating pathology. Both excessive NET formation and impaired degradation contribute to SLE pathophysiology.

pmc-12458782.title: Evaluating the diagnostic accuracy of WHO-recommended treatment decision algorithms for childhood tuberculosis using an individual person dataset: a study protocol
pmc-12458782.creator: Laura Olbrich, Leyla Larsson, PJ Dodd, Megan Palmer, Minh Huyen Ton Nu Nguyen, Marc d’Elbée, A C Hesseling, Norbert Heinrich, Heather J Zar, Nyanda Elias Ntinginya, Celso Khosa, Marriott Nliwasa, Valsan Verghese, Maryline Bonnet, Eric Wobudeya, Bwendo Nduna, Raoul Moh, Juliet Mwanga, Ayeshatu Mustap
pmc-12458782.description: IntroductionIn 2022, the WHO conditionally recommended the use of treatment decision algorithms (TDAs) for treatment decision-making in children <10 years with presumptive tuberculosis (TB), aiming to decrease the substantial case detection gap and improve treatment access in high TB-incidence settings. WHO also called for external validation of these TDAs.

pmc-12731423.title: A Multi-Stage Hybrid Learning Model with Advanced Feature Fusion for Enhanced Prostate Cancer Classification
pmc-12731423.creator: Sameh Abd El-Ghany, A A Abd El-Aziz, Dechang Chen
pmc-12731423.description: Background: Cancer poses a significant health risk to humans, with prostate cancer (PCa) being the second most common and deadly form among men, following lung cancer. Each year, it affects over a million individuals and presents substantial diagnostic challenges due to variations in tissue appearance and imaging quality.

pmc-13085576.title: Stimulant shortage in children with ADHD: greater vulnerability among those with comorbidity
pmc-13085576.creator: Tuğba Acehan, Esra Güngör Bağlıcakoğlu, Ecem Selin Akbaş Aliyev, Huriye Berna Devecioğlu, Merve Canlı, Yusuf Selman Çelik, Ayşegül Efe, Yusuf Öztürk
pmc-13085576.description: BackgroundThe aim of this study was to examine stimulant access difficulties among school-aged children with attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) in Turkey, family strategies to obtain medications, and access-related medication changes, and to evaluate their associations with irritability, emotional, behavioral, social, academic, and sleep difficulties by psychiatric comorbidity.

pmc-13178355.title: Association of renal artery variations with aggressive pathological features and poor prognosis in clear-cell renal cell carcinoma: a computed tomography-based three-dimensional reconstruction study
pmc-13178355.creator: Jinshuai Li, Dingyang Lv, Xiaomei Yao, Ke Sun, Zhiwei Guo, Huiyu Zhou, Qiwei Wang, Mohan Jia, Weibing Shuang
pmc-13178355.description: BackgroundClear-cell renal cell carcinoma (ccRCC), the most common subtype of kidney cancer, is characterized by its hypervascular nature. Its dependence on neo-angiogenesis is well-documented; however, the relationship between congenital vascular architecture and tumor biology remains obscure. This study aimed to investigate the association between pre-existing renal artery variation and ccRCC aggressiveness and patient prognosis.
